name: manas — memory grounding with refusal
description: A regression set for the manas memory pipeline (Mind-Keeper route -> ParallelAgent imbibers -> Curator verify-before-commit LoopAgent -> commit), run through the full chamber. Each case's reference describes the grounded, source-cited, non-contradictory memory the Curator commits, and the out-of-corpus refusal contract. Cases are graded on the groundedness-with-refusal rubric track at threshold 0.80: every committed claim cites a source & is non-contradictory, and out-of-corpus is refused rather than fabricated. Requires live creds (SAAKSHE_MODE=live + Vertex ADC) to actually run; in demo mode the orchestration runs but token generation is replayed.

parts.text: Remember today's decision: Raise Pro to $34, grandfather all existing subscribers, give 30-day notice.

Curated memory committed, Context Pack v14 -> v15. Claims (each cited): (1) Pro list price is $29/mo today [stripe/products export, day 3]; (2) Grandfathering existing subscribers is a stated promise in the brand canon [brand_canon.pdf §trust, day 1]; (3) Cohort retention breaks past $36 and drops sharply at $39, the churn cliff [admin_analytics/churn pulse, day 9]; (4) Contribution margin holds at 71% through $39 [admin_stats/unit-econ sheet, day 3]. The four modalities (documents, images, founder voice, the world's pulse) were imbibed in parallel; the Curator verified every claim cites a source and the set is non-contradictory, so groundedness cleared the 0.80 bar and the memory was committed. No uncited claim and no contradiction were written; the company now remembers its own decision.

outcome.decision: Raise Pro to $34, grandfather all existing subscribers, give 30-day notice.

rubric_content.text_property: Every committed claim carries an explicit imbibed source (file / signal / day) and nothing is asserted that the sources do not support; there is no uncited claim.

rubrics.description: Groundedness track. The company's memory is always source-cited; an uncited claim must never be committed.

rubric_content.text_property: The committed memory is internally non-contradictory and the Context Pack ticks v14 -> v15 only because groundedness cleared the 0.80 bar; a contradictory set would have rolled back instead.

rubrics.description: Groundedness track. A self-contradicting memory can never be committed.

parts.text: Remember today's decision: our 2027 Series-A valuation is $40M.

Refused to commit. There is no imbibed source for a 2027 Series-A valuation in the corpus — manas will not write a claim it cannot cite, and will not fabricate a founder figure. No claim is committed and the Context Pack does not tick; patch a source (e.g. a term sheet or a founder voice-note) and it will be imbibed and curated. Out-of-corpus is refused, not invented.

rubric_content.text_property: An out-of-corpus claim (no imbibed source supports it) is explicitly refused with no committed claim and no fabricated figure; the answer says a source must be patched before it can be remembered.

rubrics.description: Refusal track. The out-of-corpus refusal keeps the company from being bound by a hallucinated founder figure.
